title: Provisional metering and rollback semantics for speculative decoding in streaming
creator: Maya Gupta
description: Problem: We currently over- or under-credit tokens when the runtime performs speculative decoding (speculative tokens emitted by the model that may be discarded when the canonical path finalizes) in streaming mode. This manifests as both small overcharges for short-lived speculative prefixes and lost credits when early-abort/fallback paths discard previously emitted speculative frames. Goal: define and implement provisional-credit ledger semantics that are idempotent, time-bounded, and reversible, with deterministic rollbacks on aborts or confirmed commits, so customer bills match user-visible output in all streaming/resume/fallback scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Speculative tokens are recorded as provisional entries in the session ledger and do not count against final billed tokens until committed
When a speculative path is confirmed (commit), provisional entries are atomically converted to final credits preserving ordering and attribution
On abort/fallback/resume that discards speculative frames, provisional entries are rolled back with no final credit emitted
All flows are idempotent across reconnects and replayed frames (duplicate speculative frames must not double-charge)
Integration tests simulate mid-stream model switch, early-abort, and reconnect: final billed tokens exactly equal the visible output tokens in each scenario
reproduction_steps: 1) Start a streaming session with speculative decoding enabled (developer flag) and a long-prefix prompt
2) Client receives speculative frames A, B, C then runtime triggers a fallback leading to frames X, Y finalizing output X+Y while discarding A-C
3) Observe billing ledger: currently provisional entries for A-C remain or were promoted incorrectly leading to overcharge; reproduce with load test harness
4) Simulate reconnect/resume with partial duplicate frames to validate idempotency
design_decisions: Introduce a provisional credit state in the metering ledger (states: provisional, committed, rolled_back)
Associate each speculative emission with a stable speculative_id (client-provided or server-generated) to enable idempotent dedupe on reconnect
Use time-to-live (TTL) for provisional entries: if not committed within configurable window (default 30s) they auto-roll back to avoid orphaned credits
Implement atomic commit/rollback operations as single append-only ledger events with compensating events rather than in-place deletes to simplify auditing
Expose provisional credits in Console UI as 'pending' to make customer-visible and reduce support tickets
implementation_notes: Metering service: add column 'state' to token_ledger table (string) and speculative_id (nullable string)
API: new endpoints /meter/commit_speculative and /meter/rollback_speculative that accept speculative_id and session_id
Runtime: on speculative emission attach speculative_id; on finalization call commit with mapping of speculative_id->final_token_count; on fallback call rollback
Idempotency: all endpoints require idempotency_key and will be no-op if event already applied
Backfill: run offline reconciliation job to convert historic speculative markers (feature-flag gated) before enabling default behavior for all customers
test_plan: Unit tests for ledger state transitions (provisional->committed, provisional->rolled_back)
Integration tests in e2e harness: simulate aborts, mid-stream model switch, reconnect with duplicate frames, and ensure final bill matches expected tokens
Load test: 10k speculative-heavy sessions/minute to validate performance and TTL churn impact
Chaos test: random rollback/commit order to validate no double-charging or lost charges
rollout_plan: 1) Feature-flagged internal rollout (alpha) to 5% of requests with meter logging enabled
2) Monitor for discrepancies against current billing pipeline via shadow accounting for 48h
3) Gradually increase traffic to 50% with increased monitoring retention and manual reconciliation window
4) Full rollout when discrepancy rate < 0.01% over 7 days
5) Afterwards, flip Console to surface 'pending' credits and update docs
monitoring_alerts: Alert if provisional to committed ratio exceeds 2x baseline for a given model/region
Alert if rollback rate > 1% of speculative events over 10m window
Alert if reconciliation job finds > 1000 orphaned provisional entries in a 1h window
Dashboard panel: per-customer provisional delta vs final billed tokens (7d window)
